pages.text: GOOD WORK, DENJI. THIS GUY'S CORPSE'LL FETCH A PRETTY PENNY ON THE BLACK MARKET.

pages.text: THANKS!!

pages.text: AND THEN THERE'S THE COMMISSION FOR REFERRING YOL AND ASSOCIATED FEES...

pages.text: THERE'S A MEASLY 1800 YEN LEFT. IT'S A GODDAMN MIRACLE, THE MONEY JUST VANISHED INTO THIN AIR.

pages.text: THERE'S NOTHIN' TO EAT AT HOME EITHER...

pages.text: POCHITA...

pages.speaker: character9
pages.text: WHY’RE YOU USING A BRAT LIKE HIM AS A DEVIL HUNTER?

pages.text: TO GET BACK THE MONEY WE’RE OWED.

pages.speaker: character8
pages.text: THOUGH IT WAS HIS PIECE OF SHIT POPS WHO DIED WITHOUT PAYING UP.

pages.speaker: character6
pages.text: STILL, IS IT REALLY OKAY TO HIRE A SHITHEAD WITH A PET DEVIL AS A DEVIL HUNTER?

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: THING IS, A REAL DEVIL HUNTER, WON'T JUST LET YAKUZA TAKE THE CORPSE AFTERWARDS.

pages.text: HIS OTHER REDEEMING QUALITY IS THAT HE ALWAYS DOES AS HE’S TOLD.
